_notes: One entry per speaker in story/main.dialogue. voice_name is the LuvVoice name (from narration/narration_script_english.txt where chosen); voice_id is what the API needs. Fill voice_id in from the LuvVoice dashboard or `python3 tools/voice/generate.py --list-voices`.
voice_type is 'standard' for LuvVoice's preset voices, 'cloned' for cloned and Featured public custom voices (Holden Nash is one).
rate, pitch and volume are passed straight to the API; 0 is the voice's default.
Changing any of these marks that speaker's clips stale, so the next run regenerates them.
skip: true leaves the speaker out of generation (the animals are better as sound effects).

voice_of: "nephi" gives a speaker another speaker's voice settings (voice_common.load_cast). The artifacts (story/artifacts.gd) use it: they are their own speakers, so their balloons show their picture and name, but Nephi says their lines.

pronunciations._notes: Whole-word replacements made only in the text sent to LuvVoice; the on-screen text is unchanged. Nephi and Lehi are the spellings the intro narration used. Add more as names come out wrong (Laman, Lemuel, Ishmael, Zoram, Laban).

variables._notes: Values a {{variable}} in a line can take. Each line using one gets a clip per value, named <ID>__<value>.mp3. For example "fruit": ["apples", "figs"], for a line like "These are delicious {{fruit}}." In Spanish the words each value puts into the line are its translation in es.po.

narrator.description: Older Nephi reading the scripture scroll verses (story/scriptures.gd), as in the intro narration. Clips are named by verse key, e.g. voice/narrator/1_nephi_17_8.mp3. Your notes: Steffan, default settings.

nephi.description: Young Nephi, the player. Faithful, earnest, respectful to his father. Your notes: Ben, default settings (Steffan is the older Nephi narrating).

lehi.description: The prophet and father. Old, warm, deep and steady.

sariah.description: Nephi's mother. Warm, tired from the journey, quietly faithful. Needs a mature woman's voice.

laman.description: Eldest brother. Scornful and sarcastic until humbled. Suggested: David (slightly sarcastic, casual).

lemuel.description: Second brother, follows Laman's lead, whiny. Suggested: Roger (higher, annoying, casual). Should sound clearly different from Laman.

sam.description: Third brother, loyal to Nephi, cheerful. Suggested: Andrew (young man, clear).

jacob.description: Youngest brother, born in the wilderness; a young child. Needs a child's voice, or an adult voice with pitch raised.

joseph.description: Jacob's younger brother, also born in the wilderness; the smallest child. Should be distinguishable from Jacob.

zoram.description: Laban's former servant from Jerusalem. Loyal, grateful, a bit of an outsider. Suggested: Christopher (light accent, deepish).

ishmael_wife.description: Ishmael's widow. Older woman, gentle and a little grieving; should be distinguishable from Sariah.

ishmael_son_1.description: Ishmael's elder son. Sides with Laman, skeptical and grudging. Suggested: Eric (normal, deepish).

ishmael_son_2.description: Ishmael's younger son. Friends with Laman and Lemuel, easygoing, wants to rest and party. Suggested: Guy (normal, higher).

ishmael_daughter_1.description: Ishmael's eldest daughter, Zoram's wife. Composed, admiring.

ishmael_daughter_2.description: Laman's wife. Frank and practical, a little wry about her husband.

ishmael_daughter_4.description: Lemuel's wife. Hopeful but a little exasperated.

ishmael_daughter_5.description: Nephi's wife (she calls him husband). Warm, proud of him, caring. The most prominent of the daughters.

sister_1.description: Nephi's sister, the older of the two. Cheerful, dreamy, looking forward to the voyage. A girl or young woman.

sister_2.description: Nephi's younger sister. Excited about collecting shells; childlike.

sheep.description: Baa. Use a real sheep sound effect.

goat.description: Maaa. Use a real goat sound effect.

chicken.description: Bawk. Use a real chicken sound effect.
